```{r, message=FALSE}
# =========================================================
# 0) packages
# =========================================================
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# =========================================================
# 1) read data
# =========================================================
division_10yr <- read_csv("../data/missing_data/Inferred-WONDER-Census Division-Sex-10Yr.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
division_5yr  <- read_csv("../data/missing_data/Inferred-WONDER-Census Division-Sex-5Yr.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
region_10yr   <- read_csv("../data/missing_data/Inferred-WONDER-Census Region-Sex-10Yr.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
region_5yr    <- read_csv("../data/missing_data/Inferred-WONDER-Census Region-Sex-5Yr.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# 2) helpers: standardize columns + parse age bounds
# =========================================================
standardize_cols <- function(df) {
  # find columns robustly (handles "Age Groups" vs "Age Group", etc.)
  nms <- names(df)

  age_col   <- "Age Groups"
  month_col <- "Month Code"
  deaths_col <- "Deaths"

  if (length(age_col) != 1 || length(month_col) != 1 || length(deaths_col) != 1) {
    stop(
      "Could not uniquely identify columns for Age Groups / Month Code / Deaths.\n",
      "Found age_col=", paste(age_col, collapse=", "), "\n",
      "Found month_col=", paste(month_col, collapse=", "), "\n",
      "Found deaths_col=", paste(deaths_col, collapse=", ")
    )
  }

  df %>%
    rename(
      age_groups = all_of(age_col),
      month_code = all_of(month_col),
      deaths_raw = all_of(deaths_col)
    )
}

parse_age_bounds <- function(age_str) {
  s <- str_to_lower(str_trim(age_str))

  # extract all integers in the string
  nums <- str_extract_all(s, "\\d+") |> lapply(as.integer)

  lower <- rep(NA_integer_, length(s))
  upper <- rep(NA_integer_, length(s))

  # 2 numbers => range like "15-19 years"
  idx2 <- lengths(nums) >= 2
  lower[idx2] <- vapply(nums[idx2], `[[`, integer(1), 1)
  upper[idx2] <- vapply(nums[idx2], `[[`, integer(1), 2)

  # 1 number => could be "85+ years" or "15 years"
  idx1 <- lengths(nums) == 1
  lower[idx1] <- vapply(nums[idx1], `[[`, integer(1), 1)
  upper[idx1] <- lower[idx1]

  # plus sign => treat upper as Inf (we’ll drop later anyway if >54)
  has_plus <- str_detect(s, "\\+")
  upper[has_plus] <- 999L

  tibble(age_lower = lower, age_upper = upper)
}

# =========================================================
# 3) clean + compute suppressed percent (15–54 only)
# =========================================================
clean_one <- function(df, dataset_label) {
  df2 <- standardize_cols(df)

  age_bounds <- parse_age_bounds(df2$age_groups)

  df2 %>%
    bind_cols(age_bounds) %>%
    mutate(
      # Month Code like "1999/01" -> date at first day of month
      month = ym(str_replace_all(month_code, "/", "-")),
      deaths_raw = as.character(deaths_raw),
      suppressed = str_detect(str_to_lower(deaths_raw), "suppress")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_lower), !is.na(age_upper)) %>%
    filter(age_lower >= 15, age_upper <= 54) %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      age_group = str_trim(age_groups)
    ) %>%
    select(dataset, month, age_lower, age_upper, age_group, suppressed)
}

d10 <- clean_one(division_10yr, "division_10yr")
d5  <- clean_one(division_5yr,  "division_5yr")
r10 <- clean_one(region_10yr,   "region_10yr")
r5  <- clean_one(region_5yr,    "region_5yr")

# (A) a reusable theme + scales (keeps plots consistent)
theme_ts <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 12, 10, 12)
  )

scale_x_month <- scale_x_date(
  date_breaks = "1 year",
  date_labels = "%Y"
)

scale_y_pct <- scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 100),
  breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
)

scale_age_colors <- scale_color_brewer(
  palette = "Dark2",
  guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
)

# (B) helper that builds one plot for one dataset
make_one_plot <- function(dat, dataset_name) {
  dat_one <- dat %>%
    filter(dataset == dataset_name) %>%
    mutate(age_group = fct_reorder(age_group, age_lower))

  ggplot(dat_one, aes(x = month, y = suppressed_pct, color = age_group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.95) +
    scale_x_month +
    scale_y_pct +
    scale_age_colors +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Suppression rate over time (ages 15–54): ", dataset_name),
      x = "Month",
      y = "Suppressed (%)",
      color = "Age group"
    ) +
    theme_ts
}

# (C) build each plot separately
p_div_10yr <- make_one_plot(supp_ts, "division_10yr")
p_div_5yr  <- make_one_plot(supp_ts, "division_5yr")
p_reg_10yr <- make_one_plot(supp_ts, "region_10yr")
p_reg_5yr  <- make_one_plot(supp_ts, "region_5yr")

# (D) print each graph separately
print(p_div_10yr)
print(p_div_5yr)
print(p_reg_10yr)
print(p_reg_5yr)

# optional save
# ggsave("suppressed_percent_15_54_timeseries.png", p, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

```
